_comment: District 8 (GDD §4.1 chain order), Act II chain territory (GDD §12.3 D4-8). Prereq verified in data/districts/district_warehouses.tres: powered_by = [&"hospital"]; warehouses is NOT a leaf — industrial.powered_by = [warehouses, police] (the D8/D9 convergence). Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): crawler, destroyer, hunter — CRAWLER leads here: it outruns the player (1.5x) but sees only 6 m and flinches in light for 1 s (GDD §6.2), so light is a disengage tool, not a weapon, and rack aisles are the cover. Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): cable, fuse, scrap — the district is literally the grid's parts depot, which the lore leans on (warehouses_note_03/08 count drums 12-18). Blueprint CANON: BLUEPRINTS[warehouses] = blueprint_backpack_slots (the D8 backpack slots schematic). Story doc canon: doc_foreman_note ('the conveyor thinks it is the foreman' — 20 years on the floor), extended, never copied, by warehouses_note_04/06. Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd switch_warehouses (reward 150 coins, power_stage 2). Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Grid-crew leftovers at the feeder desk (warehouses_note_03 states the stores check in-world); the switch room is open from the west hall.

Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Spare fuses in the yard flood breaker box; warehouses_note_03 tags 'the rack by the yard flood box', note_08 says the crew later took the tagged rack — this second set lives in the breaker box itself, which the crew's count missed.

Guarantee: transistor for FULL. The quarantine solid-state (the only transistors in the district — warehouses_note_03/07). The cage is locked; opened by warehouses_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Quarantine-cage key in the foreman's unlocked mezzanine desk drawer — the one drawer the belt never learned to open. Reachable in DARK with zero tools (R1).
BLUEPRINTS canon: the D8 backpack-slots schematic. In the office locker with the shift records; guaranteed, never rolled (R7), reachable in DARK.
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT): pallet of banding-offcuts and broken cage mesh on rack A. The depot must pay out materials at DARK; non-RNG by R6.

Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT): an un-numbered drum lot behind rack B — the crew's log counts drums 12-18 only (warehouses_note_03), so a drum the crew never logged is exactly what the belt would leave.
Shift-room first-aid in the unlocked locker; the depot is all steel edges and nobody left to patch you up.
Ready-made defense cache in the yard dumpster; STREETS only (R2). Kept out of the sheds and off the feeder-room pad (R8 fire discipline near quarantine).
Battery top-up on arrival from the hospital road; the dock gate is the district's safe pocket, and the whole complex is long sightlines in fog.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor); the cage key (warehouses_fix_key_01) sits in the foreman's unlocked desk drawer, so the transistors are reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot. None of the three chain components sits in the destroyer's room (R5).

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. molotov enters rolls at PARTIAL, noise_bomb at STREETS; fuse and transistor never roll in DARK (the yard flood box and the quarantine cage are the DARK sources), mirroring the police pack's discipline.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.

R4: No firearms in warehouses. There is no pistol/rifle/ammo id in data/items. molotov/noise_bomb remain the combat ceiling; the district hands out parts (cable/fuse/scrap) and lets the switch_warehouses puzzle pay coins (150).

R5: Crawler-led (enemy_pool.gd [crawler, destroyer, hunter]): crawlers outrun the player (1.5x) but see only 6 m and flinch out of the light for 1 s (GDD §6.2) — the flashlight is a disengage tool here, never a kill weapon; rack aisles break their 120-degree cones. The destroyer (no light reaction) holds the cold annex dead-end, and no chain spawn or key sits in that room, so a player who never fights it still finishes via R1.

R6: Scripted caches must not roll empty: the returns cage, the office key drawer, the yard flood box and the stores racks are fixed payouts (mirrors park's keeper shed, school's shelter, hospital's pharmacy, police's armory/evidence).

R7: Blueprint guarantee: warehouses_fix_blueprint_01 (blueprint_backpack_slots) is the district's one schematic per district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS. It is a fixed spawn, never a roll, reachable in DARK. No other blueprint id may spawn here.

R8: z_cold_storage and z_returns_cage never relight at any stage (mirrors police holding cells, hospital morgue): no streetlight_3d in either, and global relight passes must skip them. The quarantine cage gets no lamp even at FULL — the player reads it by the corridor spill (the district's own R-rule, in-world at warehouses_note_07). Fire discipline: no molotov cache inside the sheds or the feeder room.
